title: KCP space_participant_activate request (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 activation family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Activates the exact proposed participant: consumes the prepared subject digest named by its §11.6.1 activation row (gap note KG19). The acceptance receipt or standing-policy use is authority material bound by the operator surface, never a wire argument (gap note KG19); activation cannot rewrite the proposal. Registry (shared_space_v1): surface operator / authenticated principal; narrow policy service consuming an exact active standing-policy/contract receipt (assurance: current assurance required by policy). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

subject_digest.description: The §11.6.1 activation row's exact prepared subject digest (gap note KG19); a changed proposal fails the digest match.

args.description: Exact prepared subject consumption (gap note KG19); role, kind, and subject changes require a new proposal.

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
